info.name: Jubis ERP QA — disposable staging only
info.description: Session/CSRF contracts; exact statuses. IDs are synthetic fixture IDs. Do not run against production. Full business assertions live in PHPUnit and the strategy; this collection is an endpoint smoke starter. Signed webhook happy request requires external valid signature header over exact substituted raw body. Stateful requests require sequencing and correct fixture status.

exec: if (pm.variables.get('QA_TARGET') !== 'disposable') throw new Error('Set QA_TARGET=disposable only on a synthetic test environment.');
const base = pm.variables.get('base_url');
if (!/^https?:\/\/(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost)(:\d+)?$/.test(base) && pm.variables.get('QA_ALLOW_REMOTE') !== 'true') throw new Error('Remote staging requires QA_ALLOW_REMOTE=true.');
if (pm.request.method !== 'GET' && pm.variables.get('QA_ALLOW_MUTATIONS') !== 'true') throw new Error('Write tests require QA_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true.');
const token = pm.cookies.get('XSRF-TOKEN'); if (token) pm.variables.set('csrf_token', decodeURIComponent(token));
